Incredible afternoon to close out National Library Week! 📚

We had a full house to view the PBS documentary ‘The Librarians’ along with a panel discussion of local library leaders, moderated by @bplboston President David Leonard. Protecting the freedom to read is essential for a healthy democracy and the @bplfund was proud to support this screening to shine a light on book banning.

In these final hours of National Library Week, now is the time to show your support of libraries and make a gift at bplfund.org. Link in bio.

🏃Meet Team BPL Runner, Charlie!

"I’m a senior at Boston College, and ever since watching the Boston Marathon my freshman year, I’ve been set on running it myself before graduating. I’m incredibly fortunate to be running this spring on behalf of the Boston Public Library.

Education has transformed my life and shaped who I am today—but it is also incredibly expensive and often out of reach for many. The BPL makes books, learning, and educational resources accessible to anyone who walks through its doors, completely free of charge."

4 days to Marathon Monday!💙
